stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Job Agent 3.0.13 Beta improves Dashboard history accuracy and employer response tracking after real macOS logs confirmed 52 manually submitted applications. On every Dashboard refresh, confirmed submissions are prioritized over stale APPLY/REVIEW and manual queue overrides: sent vacancies are shown under Submitted, not as new ready applications, while original scores and decision history remain available. Current openings are listed before sent applications in All. A visible action on each confirmed submitted vacancy lets the user manually record recruiter contact, interview, rejection, offer or reminder using the existing local response tracking editor. No employer decision is inferred from a successful Submit. Company labels now survive a later blank discovery snapshot and can be restored from saved application history; a conservative HTTP enrichment fallback reads the displayed company only from an explicit employer profile link, excluding unrelated navigation and generic labels. Local vacancy snapshots retain the source of a company label. No changes to candidate CV selection, search limits, scoring thresholds, browser fallback, pending manual handoff or final manual-only Submit. Offline regression suite passed 188/188 tests including real offscreen Qt Dashboard tests. Validate Beta update on Mac: previously submitted jobs should not appear under fresh APPLY, submission count should remain 52, and response-stage edits must preserve submitted status.
